arxiv-2102-07343.title: Capturing Detailed Deformations of Moving Human Bodies 85 Journal: TOG Journal: TOG Volume: 40 4 85 8 DOI: 10.1145/3450626.3459792 CCS: Computing methodologies Motion capture
arxiv-2102-07343.creator: He Chen, Hyojoon Park, Kutay Macit, Ladislav Kavan
arxiv-2102-07343.description: Abstract . We present a new method to capture detailed human motion, sampling more than 1000 unique points on the body. Our method outputs highly accurate 4D (spatio-temporal) point coordinates and, crucially, automatically assigns a unique label to each of the points.

arxiv-2110-12403.title: Learning to Estimate Without Bias
arxiv-2110-12403.creator: Tzvi Diskin, Yonina C. Eldar, Ami Wiesel
arxiv-2110-12403.description: Abstract The Gauss–Markov theorem states that the weighted least squares estimator is a linear minimum variance unbiased estimation (MVUE) in linear models. In this paper, we take a first step towards extending this result to non-linear settings via deep learning with bias constraints.

arxiv-2201-00427.title: Quantum supremacy of the many-body fluctuations in the occupations of the excited particle states in a Bose-Einstein-condensed gas
arxiv-2201-00427.creator: V.V. Kocharovsky 1 , Vl.V. Kocharovsky 2 , and S.V. Tarasov 2 1 Department of Physics and Astronomy, Texas A&M University, College Station, TX 77843, USA 2 Institute of Applied Physics, Russian Academy of Sciences, Nizhny Novgorod 603950, Russia
arxiv-2201-00427.description: Abstract We find a universal analytic formula for a characteristic function (Fourier transform) of a joint probability distribution for the particle occupation numbers in a BEC gas and the Hafnian Master Theorem generalizing the famous Permanent Master Theorem of MacMahon.

arxiv-2206-08947.title: Multi-wavelength analysis of short GRB 201221D and its comparison with other high & low redshift short GRBs 2021 Multi-wavelength analysis of short GRB 201221D and its comparison with other high & low redshift short GRBs – 5
arxiv-2206-08947.creator: Dimple, K. Misra, D. A. Kann, K. G. Arun, A. Ghosh, R. Gupta, L. Resmi, J. F. Agüí Fernández, C. C. Thöne, A. de Ugarte Postigo, S. B. Pandey, L. Yadav
arxiv-2206-08947.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Dimple, K. Misra, D. A. Kann, K. G. Arun, A. Ghosh, R. Gupta, L. Resmi, J. F. Agüí Fernández, C. C. Thöne, A. de Ugarte Postigo, S. B. Pandey, L. Yadav. We present a detailed analysis of short GRB 201221D lying at redshift z = 1.045 z=1.045 . We analyse the high-energy data of the burst and compare it with the sample of short gamma-ray bursts (SGRBs).

arxiv-2212-09846.title: PullupStructs: Digital Fabrication for Folding Structures via Pull-up Nets Conference: TEI ’23: Proceedings of the Seventeenth International Conference on Tangible, Embedded, and Embodied Interaction; February 26-March 1, 2023; Warsaw, Poland TEI ’23: Proceedings of the Seventeenth International Con
arxiv-2212-09846.creator: Lauren Niu, Xinyi Yang, Martin Nisser, Stefanie Mueller
arxiv-2212-09846.description: Abstract . In this paper, we introduce a method to rapidly create 3D geometries by folding 2D sheets via pull-up nets. Given a 3D structure, we unfold its mesh into a planar 2D sheet using heuristic algorithms and populate these with cutlines and throughholes. We develop a web-based simulation tool that translates users’ 3D meshes into manufacturable 2D sheets.

arxiv-2402-04835.title: Pseudo-labelling meets Label Smoothing for Noisy Partial Label Learning
arxiv-2402-04835.creator: Darshana Saravanan, Naresh Manwani, Vineet Gandhi, IIIT Hyderabad, India
arxiv-2402-04835.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Darshana Saravanan, Naresh Manwani, Vineet Gandhi, IIIT Hyderabad, India. We motivate weakly supervised learning as an effective learning paradigm for problems where curating perfectly annotated datasets is expensive and may require domain expertise such as fine-grained classification. We focus on Partial Label Learning (PLL), a weakly-supervised learning paradigm where each training instance is paired with a set of candidate labels (partial label), one of which is the true label.

arxiv-2403-03905.title: Black-Box k k -to- 1 1 -PCA Reductions: Theory and Applications
arxiv-2403-03905.creator: Arun Jambulapati, Syamantak Kumar, Jerry Li, Shourya Pandey, Ankit Pensia, Kevin Tian
arxiv-2403-03905.description: Abstract The k k -principal component analysis ( k k -PCA) problem is a fundamental algorithmic primitive that is widely-used in data analysis and dimensionality reduction applications. In statistical settings, the goal of k k -PCA is to identify a top eigenspace of the covariance matrix of a distribution, which we only have black-box access to via samples.

arxiv-2404-10911.title: Efficient Batch and Recursive Least Squares for Matrix Parameter Estimation
arxiv-2404-10911.creator: Brian Lai, Dennis S. Bernstein
arxiv-2404-10911.description: Abstract Traditionally, batch least squares (BLS) and recursive least squares (RLS) are used for identification of a vector of parameters which form a linear model. In some situations however, it is of interest to identify parameters in a matrix structure.

arxiv-2409-11980.title: End-to-End Learning of Transmitter and Receiver Filters in Bandwidth Limited Fiber Optic Communication Systems
arxiv-2409-11980.creator: Søren Føns Nielsen, Francesco Da Ros, Mikkel N. Schmidt, Darko Zibar
arxiv-2409-11980.description: Abstract This paper investigates the application of end-to-end (E2E) learning for joint optimization of pulse-shaper and receiver filter to reduce intersymbol interference (ISI) in bandwidth-limited communication systems. We investigate this in two numerical simulation models: 1) an additive white Gaussian noise (AWGN) channel with bandwidth limitation and 2) an intensity modulated direct detection (IM/DD) link employing an electro-absorption modulator.

arxiv-2501-11332.title: Inverse Stefan problems of determining the time-dependent source coefficient and heat flux function
arxiv-2501-11332.creator: Targyn A. Nauryz 1,2 , Khumoyun Jabbarkhanov 3
arxiv-2501-11332.description: Abstract This paper delves into the Inverse Stefan problem, specifically focusing on determining the time-dependent source coefficient in the parabolic heat equation governing heat transfer in a semi-infinite rod. The problem entails the intricate task of uncovering both temperature- and time-dependent coefficients of the source while accommodating Dirichlet and Neumann boundary conditions.

arxiv-2507-18254.title: Axion Searches at the CERN SPS: From Their Dawn to Current Prospects
arxiv-2507-18254.creator: Paolo Crivelli*, Martina Mongillo
arxiv-2507-18254.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Paolo Crivelli*, Martina Mongillo. This mini-review traces the evolution of axion searches at the CERN Super Proton Synchrotron (SPS), beginning with the early proposal by Guido Barbiellini in 1982 and culminating in the recent advances of the NA62 and NA64 experiments. We discuss the experimental strategies employed in early beam dump searches, the current status of axion and axion-like particle (ALPs) searches at the CERN SPS and future directions.

arxiv-2509-14043.title: Searching for radio emission from radio quiet magnetars with MeerKAT
arxiv-2509-14043.creator: Marlon L. Bause, Kamalpreet Kaur, Isabella Rammala-Zitha, Laura G. Spitler
arxiv-2509-14043.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Marlon L. Bause, Kamalpreet Kaur, Isabella Rammala-Zitha, Laura G. Spitler. Magnetars are neutron stars that occupy the extreme end of the neutron star population, with magnetic field strengths of more than 10 12 10^{12} G \mathrm{G} . They have been proposed as one of the most likely progenitor models for the phenomenon of energetic, ms-duration, extragalactic radio bursts (FRBs), which has been increased even further due to the FRB-like bursts emitted from the galactic Magnetar SGR 1935+2154.

arxiv-2510-26079.title: A note on the tetrahedral index and the Hahn-Exton q q -Bessel function
arxiv-2510-26079.creator: Daniele Celoria
arxiv-2510-26079.description: Abstract . The purpose of this short note is twofold: First to elucidate some connections between the “building block” of Dimofte–Gaiotto–Gukov’s 3 3 D index, known as the tetrahedral index I Δ ​ ( m , e ) I_{\Delta}\left(m,e\right) , and Hahn–Exton’s q q -analogue of the Bessel function J ν ​ ( z , q ) J_{\nu}\left(z;q\right) .

plos-pone-0003793.creator: Catherine J. Pears, Kelly Thornber, Jocelyn M. Auger et al.
plos-pone-0003793.description: PLOS ONE research article. Increasing evidence suggests that individual isoforms of protein kinase C (PKC) play distinct roles in regulating platelet activation. In this study, we focus on the role of two novel PKC isoforms, PKCδ and PKCε, in both mouse and human platelets. PKCδ is robustly expressed in hu

pmc-10584373.title: High-content microscopy reveals a morphological signature of bortezomib resistance
pmc-10584373.creator: Megan E Kelley, Adi Y Berman, David R Stirling, Beth A Cimini, Yu Han, Shantanu Singh, Anne E Carpenter, Tarun M Kapoor, Gregory P Way, Caigang Liu
pmc-10584373.description: Drug resistance is a challenge in anticancer therapy. In many cases, cancers can be resistant to the drug prior to exposure, that is, possess intrinsic drug resistance. However, we lack target-independent methods to anticipate resistance in cancer cell lines or characterize intrinsic drug resistance without a priori knowledge of its cause.

pmc-11341809.title: The control method of a quadrotor driven by bidirectional electronic speed controllers
pmc-11341809.creator: Lihao Xu, Zhiduan Cai, Yuling Wang, Zhongyi Shen
pmc-11341809.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). In this paper, a dynamic quadrotor unmanned aircraft vehicle driven by bidirectional electronic speed controllers is proposed to enhance maneuverability and stability. Bidirectional electronic speed controllers are applied to achieve rapid deceleration of motors during flight. To match with bidirectional electronic speed controllers, fractional order Proportional-Integral-Derivative (PID) controllers are considered to attain better rapidity compared to PID controllers, and an innovative control allocation matrix with direction symbols is developed.

pmc-11517545.title: Social determinants and drivers of use of SARS-CoV-2 self-tests in a French national cohort study
pmc-11517545.creator: S Garnier, J Warszawski, the EpiCov study group
pmc-11517545.description: BackgroundSelf-tests for SARS-CoV-2 became quickly available after the onset of the epidemic. They were especially recommended for high-risk and hard-to-reach populations. This study examines whether self-tests successfully reached vulnerable groups during first months of availability in France.MethodsThe EpiCov study is a national population-based cohort study conducted in France during the Covid-19 pandemic.

pmc-11541494.title: A comprehensive review of titanium dioxide nanoparticles in cementitious composites
pmc-11541494.creator: J. Jenima, M. Priya Dharshini, M.L. Ajin, J. Jebeen Moses, Krishna Priya Retnam, Krishna Prakash Arunachalam, Siva Avudaiappan, Ramon Francisco Arrue Munoz
pmc-11541494.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Nanomaterials are incorporated to improve the characteristics of conventional concrete materials. Among them, Titanium dioxide (TiO2) nanoparticles exhibit sustainable concrete features such as optimization of materials, improvement of structures, recycling, and innovative waste management in materials and processes.

pmc-11640676.title: Lactiplantibacillus plantarum for the Preparation of Fermented Low-Bitter Enzymatic Skim Milk with Antioxidant Ability
pmc-11640676.creator: Yi Jiang, Longfei Zhang, Yushi Jin, Haiyan Xu, Yating Liang, Zihan Xia, Chenchen Zhang, Chengran Guan, Hengxian Qu, Yunchao Wa, Wenqiong Wang, Yujun Huang, Ruixia Gu, Dawei Chen, Barbaros Özer
pmc-11640676.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). A high degree of hydrolysis can reduce the allergenicity of milk, while lactic acid bacteria (LAB) fermentation can further enhance the antioxidant ability of enzymatic milk. LAB with a strong antioxidant ability was screened, and the effects of LAB on the bitterness, taste and flavor of enzymatic skim milk (ESM) with a high degree of hydrolysis were investigated in this paper, in addition to the response surface methodology optimized the conditions of the LAB fermentation of ESM.

pmc-11672321.title: Artificial Microglia Nanoplatform Loaded With Anti‐RGMa in Acoustic/Magnetic Feld for Recanalization and Neuroprotection in Acute Ischemic Stroke
pmc-11672321.creator: Ruiqi Cheng, Xiaoqin Luo, Xiaohui Wu, Zijie Wang, Ziqun Chen, Shaoru Zhang, Hongmei Xiao, Jiaju Zhong, Rongrong Zhang, Yang Cao, Xinyue Qin
pmc-11672321.description: Ischemic stroke is a leading cause of death and disability worldwide, and the main goals of stroke treatment are to destroy the thrombus to recanalize blood vessels and protect tissue from ischemia/reperfusion injury. However, current recanalization therapies have serious limitations and there are few neuroprotection methods.

pmc-12608433.title: Assessing Appetite–Validation of a Picture-Based Appetite Assessment Tool for Children Aged 6–9 Years—A Pilot Study
pmc-12608433.creator: Sigal Eilat-Adar, Yoav Zeevi, Efrat Shaked, Yael Rabih, Sima Zach, Bogdana Adriana Nǎsui
pmc-12608433.description: Background: Recognizing and balancing internal and external appetite cues is critical for controlling food intake in young children. The main aim of this pilot study was to validate a Hebrew-language Picture-Based Appetite Assessment (PBAA) for 6–9-years-old children. Specifically, the scale’s ability to reflect changes in perceptions of hunger and satiety based on a story and on their actual eating experiences.

pmc-12677673.title: Electric Field‐Stimulated Autofluorescence for In Situ 3D Characterization of Polymer Defects
pmc-12677673.creator: Chaolu Niu, Potao Sun, Wenxia Sima, Tao Yuan, Ming Yang, Yuhang Yang, Yuxiang Mai, Qin Deng, Yu Zhang
pmc-12677673.description: The absence of in situ detection approaches for internal defect structures in polymers (such as microscale fillers, voids, and electrical trees) has long impeded advanced materials characterization. Herein, it is demonstrate that moderate electric fields can selectively induce intense autofluorescence at defect sites within various polymers, including epoxy resins, polyethylene, silicone rubber, and polydimethylsiloxane.

pmc-13101269.title: Hydrophobic monomer systems for dental composites: development and physicochemical evaluation of UDMA/IBOMA formulations
pmc-13101269.creator: Shaiva Thakar, Marc Hayashi, Zaher Jabbour, Reuben Kim, Shahed Al Khalifah, Deukwon Jo, Mijoo Kim
pmc-13101269.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundThe objective of this study was to evaluate UDMA/IBOMA formulations at varying ratios as hydrophobic alternatives to conventional Bis-GMA/TEGDMA dental resin composites, assessing hydrophobic properties, polymerization efficiency, mechanical performance, water sorption behavior, and color stability.MethodsA total of 120 disc specimens (15 mm × 1 mm) were prepared in four groups (n = 40): Group 1 (control) containing Bis-GMA: TEGDMA (70:30 wt%), and Groups 2–4 containing UDMA: IBOMA at 50:50, 60:40, and 70:30 wt%, respectively.

To improve the activity of Aspergillus awamori VKPM F-1262 glucoamylase N181Q (AGAM), amino acid substitutions were made in the region of substrate binding. In the case of the variant D237G, there was a 1.3–1.

pmc-13627347.title: A fully human afucosylated anti-GARP antibody PBA-0111 drives anti-tumor immunity through combined ADCC induction and TGF-β1 pathway blockade
pmc-13627347.creator: Pieter Spee, Monika Litwin, Damian Trojanowski, Connor Burns, Adrianna Dudek, Elżbieta Gołdyn, Kamilla Sołtys, Michał Sobecki, Aleksandra Świderska, Irwin Matyjaszczyk, Marek Orłowski, Piotr Mamczur, Robert Kolodziejczyk, Dmytro Piliuhin, Jiaming Xu, Ewelina Krzywińska, Sameer Deshmukh, Tomasz Klaus
pmc-13627347.description: MethodsWe have evaluated PBA-0111, a fully human antibody targeting Glycoprotein A Repetitions Predominant (GARP), designed to induce both antibody-dependent cellular cytotoxicity (ADCC) as well as blockage of Transforming Growth Factor Beta 1 (TGF-β1) activation. Functional assessments included in vitro cytotoxicity assays, inhibition of GARP/TGF-β1 complex formation and inhibition of TGF-β1 signaling.

pmc-13672943.title: Putting the Onus on the Offenders: Implementing Project Cautioning And Relationship Abuse Awareness Raising Workshops for Alleged First-Time Offenders of Domestic Violence and Abuse
pmc-13672943.creator: Hayley Alderson, Sara Morgan, Jessica Roy, Rachel Armitage, Ruth McGovern, William McGovern, Lydia Shrimpton, Emma Hazan, Stephanie Scott
pmc-13672943.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Domestic violence and abuse (DVA) is a global public health challenge. Project Cautioning And Relationship Abuse (CARA) is an out-of-court resolution used across police forces in England and Wales for lower risk, alleged first-time DVA offenders. This article reports on qualitative interviews and focus groups with professionals (police, commissioners, and CARA facilitators and managers, N = 31) about their experiences of delivering CARA following its national rollout. Reflexive thematic analysis indicated strong multiprofessional support for CARA across geographical areas.
